Activate A Interact

A corked flask of thick, rust-red liquid that clings and clots at the glass when tipped, flecked with bits of green herb and smelling of iron and crushed herbs.

Instead of dealing damage, this vial restores Hit Points to one living creature. You can either drink the vial yourself, or throw it at a willing creature within 20 feet. The creature that drinks or is hit by the vial regains @Damage[2d6[healing]] Hit Points. If the vial is drunk, it also has the elixir trait.

Coagulant A creature that recovers Hit Points from a coagulant item can't recover Hit Points from another coagulant item for 10 minutes, though it still gains their other effects.

Advanced Vial (11th level) When the vial heals a creature with half its maximum Hit Points or fewer, the coagulant trait doesn't apply to that healing.
